subject: a muscular pink paint goo crocodile monster with yellow marble streaks, lower body melting into a puddle
desc: It slowly leans back and lies down flat on its back on the floor, face up, its head on the left, its body melting and spreading into a wide sticky puddle under it, both arms raised up and open as if ready to hug someone lying on top of it.
